behavior: When a popup closes, focus goes to the first of these that can take it. The order is `finalFocus`, the trigger, the element that had focus before the popup opened, the parent popup (its first eligible tabbable element, or the popup itself when it has none), and the newest element that had focus before an earlier open. When the open interaction type is `null`, the element that had focus before the popup opened comes before the trigger. An element that is not in the document, or that has the `hidden` attribute or an ancestor with it, cannot take focus. The return follows assigned slots, DOM parents and shadow hosts. It skips targets in the popup that closes and each closed popup below it, even while those popups stay mounted. When a target is in a closed popup above with a disabled focus manager, the return element of that popup replaces it, at any depth. Without this replacement, focus would stay in a popup that unmounts (`BUG-5519`). After a press on the backdrop in a browser without `preventScroll`, an eligible explicit `finalFocus` target still gets focus.
